name: Facade Thermal Transmittance
description: U-value of the building envelope after construction. Checks whether thermal performance meets energy code.

elements.name: As-Built Facade U-Value
elements.description: Actual thermal transmittance after construction. Uncertain due to insulation installation quality.

uncertainty.source: In-situ heat flux measurements from three reference buildings

elements.name: Energy Code U-Value Limit
elements.description: GEG 2023 (German Energy Efficiency Act) maximum facade U-value

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(U_facade) = U_facade if U_facade <= U_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The GEG 2023 regulatory limit guards the as-built U-value uncertainty set; only transmittances at or below 0.20 W/(m²·K) remain compliant.
